config.squ_abyssal_bloom.template: This is a template for the mod's configuration options. You can customize the settings to enhance your underwater experience and make it more immersive.
Enable progressive darkness in deep underwater
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.abyssDepthStart: Depth in blocks where the abyss effect begins
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.abyssMaxDepth.t: Depth in blocks where the abyss effect reaches maximum darkness
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.maxMarinSnowPar: Set the maximum number of marin snow particles visible underwater
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.fogDarknessInte: Multiplier for how aggressively the fog narrows at depth (1.0 = default)
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.shaderCompatMod: Force stronger overlay mode even without Oculus shaders active
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.nautilusLampInf: How much a nearby Nautilus with a Conduit lamp reduces the abyss darkness
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.marineSnowDensi: Multiplier for the number of marine snow particles spawned per tick
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.marineSnowVisib: Horizontal radius in blocks within which marine snow particles spawn
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.strictBarnacleS: Will stop any barnacle from any other mods from spawning if enabled
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.group.fog.desc: These settings control the underwater darkness effect, which simulates the lack of light in deep underwater environments. Adjusting these settings can enhance the atmosphere and immersion when exploring underwater areas.
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.group.entity.de: These settings configure the behavior of entities related to the Abyssal Bloom Mod. Adjusting these settings can affect how these entities spawn and interact with the world.
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.group.particles: These settings control the appearance of marin snow particles underwater. Adjusting these settings can enhance the visual experience when exploring underwater environments.
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.barnacle.desc: Barnacles are hostile aquatic mobs that spawn in deep underwater areas. Barnacles can swallow players whole, dealing damage over time until the player escapes or dies.
Ghost Chimeras are ethereal aquatic mobs that spawn in deep underwater areas. They are neutral and will only attack if provoked. Ghost Chimeras are translucent and have a haunting appearance and remain invisible for most of their time.
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.lampNearPlaneMu: Influence of Nautilus Lamp at Near Distance
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.lampFarPlaneMul: Influence of Nautilus Lamp at Far Distance
